verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine, so exposing low-level memory controls such as mlock or mmap is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no such overrides. The only documented switches are adjacent feature toggles (--no-prerouter, --no-lora, --max-new), and SSD expert streaming is described only as fixed default behavior, with no user-tunable memory or mmap settings.
